body_markdown:
### MCP Skills


Admins can now author reusable instructions, *skills* , that every AI tool connected through the Great Question MCP follows automatically. A skill captures how your team does something (screener conventions, incentive rules, grounding standards for insights), so agents follow your process instead of guessing at it.


Each enabled skill is advertised to connected agents with its name and description, and the agent loads the full instructions for whichever ones are relevant. Skills can also be set as prerequisites for specific MCP tools: when an agent calls a gated tool without the required skill loaded, the call is denied with a message pointing at the` get_skill` tool to load it. Manage skills under **Settings → AI & MCP** .


See[MCP: Skills](https://greatquestion.co/support/integrations/mcp-skills) .


### Richer MCP context for agents


Agents connected via MCP can now pull a structured participation event log summarizing what each participant said and did in a session, giving them richer context for analysis and follow-up. See[MCP available tools](https://greatquestion.co/support/integrations/mcp-available-tools) .
